title: MQTT Topic Router
description: An MQTT broker delivers a message to every subscriber whose filter selects its topic. Topics and filters are split at "/" into levels. A "+" matches exactly one level, a "#" at the end matches the rest (including no levels at all), any other level must match exactly, and a topic that starts with "$" is never selected by a filter that starts with a wildcard.
creator: Dan McCreary

learningObjectives: The learner will apply the "+" and "#" wildcard rules to decide which of 7 subscription filters select each of 8 topics, with at least 7 of the 8 selections exactly right.
prerequisites: topic, topic level, subscription filter, "+" wildcard, "#" wildcard, topics beginning with "$" (all defined in the section "Topics and How to Name Them" above this block).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore, then fixed-order practice items with one attempt each and immediate explained feedback
keyQuestions: Can "+" match more than one level?
commonMisconceptions: (1) "+" matches any number of levels. (2) "school/crhs/#" does not select "school/crhs". (3) "#" selects every topic, including those starting with "$".
assessmentOpportunities: Complete all eight topics. Mastery is 7 of 8 exactly right on the first submission.
